user_problem: Editors need a compact record explaining why substantive changes were made and what evidence justified them.
unique_output: A revision log linking original text, revised text, change type, rationale, source, and unresolved impact.
required_input: Before and after passages, supplied style or evidence rules, source labels, and protected text boundaries.
critical_rule: Record only observable changes and supplied rationales; do not invent author intent or rewrite protected quotations.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is terminology-consistency-editor; this documents substantive revision reasoning rather than applying glossary replacements.
acceptance_scenario: Input changes 'all users preferred' to 'six of eight participants preferred' based on note N2; quotations are protected. Output records a precision change tied to N2 and confirms no protected text changed.
